## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the relevant implementation-plan step or issue.

## Decisions

Explain choices or tradeoffs that help a reviewer assess this change. Remove this section if unnecessary.

## Validation

List commands actually run and their outcomes. For UI changes, include a screenshot or describe the browser check. State any checks not run and why.

## AI assistance and review

Link the relevant AI work-log entry. Describe what was verified or corrected in generated code; do not claim defects or checks that did not occur.

## Remaining limitations

List relevant limitations or follow-up work. Remove this section if none.
